import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 2.0,
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'legend.framealpha': 0.8,
    'legend.edgecolor': 'none',
})

COLORS = {
    'binary': '#2C3E50',
    'penalty': '#E74C3C',
    'zero': '#BDC3C7',
    'sft': '#7F7F7F',
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))

# Data
labels = ['Binary\nReward', 'Penalty\nReward']
agreement_rates = [100.0, 52.07]
bar_colors = [COLORS['binary'], COLORS['penalty']]

x = np.array([0, 1])
bar_width = 0.5

bars = ax.bar(x, agreement_rates, width=bar_width, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# 50% random chance reference line
ax.axhline(y=50, color=COLORS['sft'], linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, zorder=2, label='Random chance (50%)')

# Annotations
ax.annotate('100%\n$n$=157', xy=(0, 100), ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['binary'])

ax.annotate('52.1%\n$n$=3,000', xy=(1, 52.07), ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['penalty'])

# Zero-gradient annotation for binary
ax.annotate('60.8% of windows\nhave zero gradient\n(excluded)',
            xy=(0, 50), xytext=(0.75, 30),
            fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', ha='center', va='top',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.0,
                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'))

ax.set_ylabel('Sign-Episode\nAgreement Rate (%)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax.set_ylim(0, 115)
ax.set_yticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])
ax.set_xlim(-0.6, 1.6)

ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_1/projects/cost-verify-agent-rl/docs/paper/fig_sign_misattribution.pdf')
fig.savefig('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_1/projects/cost-verify-agent-rl/docs/paper/fig_sign_misattribution.png')
print('Done')
